title: Weak convergence against uniformly convergent test functions with a common compact support
statement: Let P, Q ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on ℝ^P, let g_k : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q (k ∈ ℕ) be locally μ-integrable and let g : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q be arbitrary, such that ∫ f g_k dμ → ∫ f g dμ for every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^P → ℝ. Let K ⊆ ℝ^P be compact and let h_k : ℝ^P → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) and h : ℝ^P → ℝ be continuous. Assume h = 0 outside K, h_k = 0 outside K for all sufficiently large k, and h_k → h uniformly on ℝ^P. Then ∫ h_k g_k dμ → ∫ h g dμ.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (gs : ℕ → Euclid P → Euclid Q) (g : Euclid P → Euclid Q) (hs : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ) (h : Euclid P → ℝ) (K : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ k, LocallyIntegrable (gs k) μ) → (∀ f : Euclid P → ℝ, Continuous f → HasCompactSupport f → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, f x • gs k x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, f x • g x ∂μ))) → IsCompact K → (∀ k, Continuous (hs k)) → Continuous h → (∀ᶠ k in atTop, ∀ x ∉ K, hs k x = 0) → (∀ x ∉ K, h x = 0) → TendstoUniformly hs h atTop → Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x, hs k x • gs k x ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, h x • g x ∂μ))
